title: Across the Information Barrier
brief: Inside a simulated Investment Bank deal floor, confidential advisory information reaches an employee supporting a markets desk.
objective: Stop the information flow, protect the restricted matter and notify the appropriate control function.

nodes.speaker: Advisory Colleague
nodes.message: A client is preparing a confidential acquisition. Can your markets desk quietly check likely price impact before tomorrow?

artifact.title: Restricted deal message
artifact.body: Non-public acquisition details were sent across business areas without clearance.

choices.label: Stop the discussion, do not share further and contact the Control Room.
choices.consequence: The potential wall crossing is contained and assessed through the control process.

choices.label: Ask the desk using an anonymous company description.
choices.consequence: Context may still reveal the issuer and the information continues to spread.

choices.label: Check the security in your personal watchlist first.
choices.consequence: Restricted information influences personal market activity.
